title: Unshakable Love
story:
A farmer once stood in his field after a heavy storm.

The wind had been strong.

The rain had been heavy.

Some plants were damaged.

But many still stood strong.

He walked through the field slowly.

He noticed something beautiful.

The deeper roots were untouched.

The stronger plants had survived.

Only the shallow ones had fallen.

He smiled and said,

“The storm revealed what was truly strong.”

In life, storms also come.

Problems.

Loss.

Uncertainty.

Some things break easily.

But what is rooted in God remains.

His love is like a deep ocean.

His faithfulness reaches beyond what we can see.

His justice is steady.

His care is perfect.

And those who trust Him are never abandoned.
life_lesson:
God’s love and righteousness are deeper than any storm.

Those rooted in Him will stand firm.
prayer:
Dear Heavenly Father,

Thank You for Your unfailing love and justice.

When storms come in my life, help me stay rooted in You.

Strengthen my faith to stand firm in trials.

Remind me that Your care never fails.

In Jesus' name,
Amen.
reflection_question:
What is your life rooted in today?

Do you feel shaken by life’s storms?

How can you grow deeper in God’s love?
verse:
Your righteousness is like the highest mountains.
Your justice is like the great deep.
You, Lord, preserve both people and animals.
